- All-New Liquid Glass Design: building upon the biophilic principles at the heart of Portal, Liquid Glass brings the fluidity and dynamic physicality of the natural world throughout the app, and in turn helps create an experience infused with a deeper sense of presence and connection. Liquid Glass requires iOS 26/iPadOS 26 & up.
- Circadian Flow: rooted in circadian science, you can now sync Portal with your local time of day. Circadian Flow plays a curated sequence of portals that follow the rhythm of the world outside - from energising mornings to restorative evenings - gently aligning your internal clock with the natural flow of the day.
- Streaming Playback: portals can now be played instantly without downloading first, making it quicker and easier to immerse yourself in nature.
- Playable Collections: you can now play entire collections and enjoy a seamless journey from one place to the next. Choose your preferred duration, and Portal will transition from one scene to another.
- Audio Normalisation: new controls balance volume levels between portals, creating smoother transitions.
- Favourites: save the portals you love most in one place.
- Search: finding the places you’re looking for, or discovering new ones just got a whole lot easier.
- Widgets: new Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Control Centre widgets for quick and easy access.
- Timers & Alarms: a new Pomodoro timer and enhanced alarm controls make it easier to focus, wind down in the evening, or wake up gently with nature. iOS 26/iPadOS 26 & up required for AlarmKit support and even more reliable alarms.
- Handoff: pick up where you left off and move seamlessly between your devices.
- Philips Hue Bridge Pro Support: expanded smart lighting support for that ultimate immersive experience.
- Improved Siri Integration: with support for media playback, search and on-screen awareness, makes finding just the right portal for the moment effortless.
- Orientation Enhancements: landscape views supported on iPhone, portrait on iPad.
- Window Resizing: supported on iPhone and iPad.

This update represents one of the biggest steps forward since we launched and we couldn’t be more excited. * How it Works *

During the entrainment process, two different carrier tones are played into the left and right ears. The frequency difference between these tones matches the brainwave frequency of the target state of mind. The listener will hear these carrier tones as an audible tone, however, when processing these two different tones the human brain will perceive the small frequency difference between the tones as an inaudible periodic beat. When exposed to this beat the listener's brainwaves will begin to synchronize with the beat frequency. What allows the human brain to perceive this beat is our directional hearing system, located in the brain stem. The brain's directional hearing system calculates frequency shifts between sound entering the left and right ear to quickly locate the direction of a sound, but when that difference is rhythmic, as with binaural tones, the brain synchronizes with the pattern. This process is more effective in the presence of background noise or ambience, which allows humans to hear and locate even subtle sounds, like an animal moving nearby in a forest that is filled with noise.

As an example, the human ear can't directly perceive the 1 - 2 Hz Delta-wave frequencies associated with deep sleep because it is well below the human hearing range, but if you wear headphones or earbuds with one side playing a 135 Hz tone and the other playing a 136 Hz tone your brain will perceive the 1 Hz difference between those frequencies as a periodic beat, in this case matching a low delta wave frequency associated with sleep. As you listen, your own brainwaves will begin to match that frequency.
